preflop: same frozen 480 specialist at all seats in both arms
warm_start: identical per-seed starting neural weights, replay rows, optimizer initialization rule, game reference and RNG state
control: reuse completed 2026-11-20 slow504 fixed-preflop training and its four scheduled snapshots; evaluate again on fresh cards

treatment_opponents.historical_selection: uniform per non-traverser seat from same seed; independent draw once per traversal, fixed over all its branches; separate deterministic selection RNG

mixture_rule: uniform private hand-level snapshot draw shared by corresponding control and treatment, same throughout the hand
new_opponent: Five seats of the upstream SolverLike heuristic. A new evaluation policy in this project. Score it separately from the established panel.
primary_measure: new mixture minus control mixture on the six previously registered pure lineups, same equal four-family weights and +100 bb/100 cap before weighting
secondary_measures: both candidates vs the original 480 specialist; absolute and paired results for each table, profitable-table count, +50/+200 cap and uncapped sensitivity; public nominal paired interval; known mixed and varied and new solver-like each separately
statistics: mean six seat rotations and three fixed model seeds within each original deal before estimating paired CIs. Use simultaneous 95% field bounds, propagated to capped score. No repeated seed or seat counted as a new deal.
decision: positive simultaneous lower bound for the primary comparison supports improvement over matched training. Check original 480, public and new opponent separately before claiming improved breadth; inconclusive or worse results remain reported. No automatic model promotion.
